name: planning
description: Turn goals, projects and decisions into practical plans. Load for roadmaps, next steps, prioritisation, schedules or comparing options.

content.inline:
# Planning

Define the desired outcome and the constraints that materially affect it. Use
what is already known; ask only for missing information that would change the
plan. State important assumptions.

Make the plan executable: identify dependencies, decisions, risks, checkpoints
and the first concrete action. Keep simple work simple. For a larger project,
separate what can happen in parallel from what is genuinely sequential and give
each step an observable completion condition.

For decisions, present the strongest viable options with their real trade-offs,
then recommend one. Update the plan when evidence changes rather than defending
an obsolete sequence. Never invent dates, owners or progress.
